programmes.d: Drew feels like his life is falling apart. Is he upset about losing Bianca, or is something bigger going on?

Grade Nine International Day is coming up and Hazel isn’t thrilled. After all, Hazel’s Jamaican and everybody loves the islands - right? When the day arrives, Hazel’s display is a hit, but she isn’t acting like herself.
When Eli shares his vision for the musical, Dave isn’t sure he has what it takes to play Romeo.

Emma Nelson is reveling in her newest job as her mom's maid of honour and planner extraordinaire! Her mom, Spike, is marrying her high-school crush, Snake - who also just happens to be Emma's favourite teacher.
Zig will do anything to impress Tori… even steal.

When Alli is offered a scholarship to MIT, her parents are bursting with pride, but is it the right choice?
Marco and Ellie are the best of friends. But Ellie is starting to want more…Marco though can’t seem to respond in kind. He’s more and more confused about what and who he’s looking for…
Alli makes a difficult choice about her future.
When class clown JT acts up in Science class, his teacher Ms. Hatzilakos gives him a serious detention - assisting her with the guinea pigs all week. JT’s annoyed.
Jenna bonds with Becky -- and Becky's hot brother, Luke -- but will religious differences come between them?

Things are looking up for Sean. He and Emma are back together. He’s a star on the basketball team. And he and Jimmy have buried the hatchet. Jimmy’s even invited him to a party. But the good feelings don’t last for long.
Jenna gets baptized, but did she do it for the wrong reasons?
Clare tries to impress Asher by pitching a story about Romeo and Jules.

Liberty can’t believe it when she doesn’t make the Girls Floor Hockey team – she’s never failed at anything. So when Coach Hatzilakos asks her to be the Team Manager, Liberty throws all her energy into managing.
A secret is eating away at Clare, but will facing the truth make things worse for her?
Ashley and Jimmy are back together, but it doesn’t feel quite the same. Ash may not look the same as last year – she’s a Goth now – but Jimmy’s sure she’s still the same golden girl inside.
Cam needs a break from hockey, so he blows off practice to hang out with Maya.

Emma’s mom is away for a few days and it’s just her and her step-dad, Mr. Simpson. He’s supportive of Emma’s involvement in “Food for Thought”; the student group who wants to remove genetically modified (GM) foods from the school cafeteria.
K.C. wants his dad out of his life -- even if it means doing something drastic.

After being in counseling for a long time, Paige is positive she’s recovered from her date rape. In fact, she’s convinced her life is back to normal – Dean and what he did are behind her forever. She never wants to see him again, so she’s dismissive.
Imogen designs an elaborate set for Romeo and Jules, and asks her mother for the money to build it.
It’s exam time and everyone’s stressed – especially Craig. In a surprise visit from his father, Craig learns that his dad is very eager to have him back in his life.
Imogen worries about her dad's odd behavior. Becky bonds with Adam without realizing that he's transgender.
Although his father is gone, Craig wants to get on with his life as normal. He insists on going back to school immediately and becomes frustrated with his friends when they behave with concern.
As Degrassi students head back to class, Drew decides the time is right to break up with Katie
The pending birth a new baby for Spike and Snake inspires Emma to search for her birth father. With some detective work, Emma discovers that her father, Shane, lives just outside the city.
After blacking out, Drew tries to piece together what happened at the party.

When Katie's anger at Drew boils over, she searches for a way to make him suffer.
Manny’s on a mission this year—it’s bye bye cute and hello hot. That means midriff baring tops, low-riders and thongs.
Drew feels like his life is falling apart. Is he upset about losing Bianca, or is something bigger going on?

Paige organizes a final hurrah at the beach and even convinces her older brother, Dylan, to act as chauffeur. Spinner’s a bit put-off by Dylan’s openly gay attitude, but his presence is an eye-opener for Marco.
Zig will do anything to impress Tori… even steal.
Spinner just can’t deal with the fact that Marco’s gay so he tries to cut Marco out of life. But when the guys all go to see Dylan’s hockey game, Jimmy makes sure that Marco comes along.
When Alli is offered a scholarship to MIT, her parents are bursting with pride, but is it the right choice?
Things haven’t been going very well for Sean lately. Emma’s busy dealing with Snake’s illness and a brand new baby brother and Tracker’s busy leading the exciting life a normal 20-something.
Alli makes a difficult choice about her future.
Things are pretty hot between Craig and Ashley, but he’s disappointed that she keeps pulling back from going all the way.
Jenna bonds with Becky -- and Becky's hot brother, Luke -- but will religious differences come between them?

Life’s getting more and more stressful for Ellie—her dad just left on another Peacekeeping Mission, her mom’s drinking again and she’s interning for Caitlin Ryan’s tv show. As things get more and more hectic, Ellie has no one to help her cope.
Jenna gets baptized, but did she do it for the wrong reasons?
Emma decides it’s time to move on in matters of the heart when she realizes she has feelings for new kid Chris.
Clare tries to impress Asher by pitching a story about Romeo and Jules.
Terri’s in heaven-- not only does she have a terrific boyfriend, the wonderful romantic Rick, she also has the lead in the school play!
A secret is eating away at Clare, but will facing the truth make things worse for her?

The holiday season is fast approaching and the Jeremiah house is abuzz - Angela has her upcoming Christmas skating pageant, Craig and Ashley are a serious item, and Joey and Sydney are getting serious.
Cam needs a break from hockey, so he blows off practice to hang out with Maya.
K.C. wants his dad out of his life -- even if it means doing something drastic.

Imogen designs an elaborate set for Romeo and Jules, and asks her mother for the money to build it.

Things are back on track for Emma now that she’s officially over Sean. Chris has even asked her out! But when she hears rumours that Sean’s part of a gang stealing things from Degrassi (including Mr. Simpson’s laptop)
Imogen worries about her dad's odd behavior. Becky bonds with Adam without realizing that he's transgender.

It’s a big gymnastics meet at Degrassi, and Manny’s going to lead the team to gold! But when she starts to feel sick, she fears that her queasy stomach might be more than the flu or even a bad nerves.
Clare writes an article that stirs up trouble at school and makes her a new enemy -- Mike Dallas.
Manny’s tempted by the romantic family scenario Craig paints and begins to think she and Craig really could keep this baby. Even Ashley shares the news with the entire cafeteria.
Eli organizes a surprise birthday party to cheer Clare up, and starts to suspect that she's hiding something.
Five kids from different worlds are stuck in a room -- on a Saturday! When Raditch introduces Saturday detention, Sean, Ellie, Hazel, Jimmy and Toby are the first inductees.
When a group of parents try to stop the play, Eli takes action.
Just when Terri thought she’d gotten over her ex boyfriend, Rick, he makes a concerted effort to win back her affections. She and her friends are wary – after all, leopards can’t change their spots.
On opening night for Romeo and Jules, Tristan is nowhere to be found.

Craig’s determined that he and the guys will be the “Last Band Standing” at Degrassi’s battle of the bands and win a spot on the show. So he sets the guys a fierce practice schedule and starts to write a killer new song.
As Becky begins to fall for Adam, she worries how her conservative parents will react.
The year-end Junior Formal is fast approaching, and Marco is in charge, except when it comes to a date. Problem is, Marco’s too nervous to ask Dylan out at all, let alone ask him to the prom.
Becky doesn't want to keep Adam a secret, so she decides to tell her parents that he's transgender.

A stressed-out Paige and Spinner decide they need a break and skip school for the day. Ashley, meanwhile, is in the doldrums, too “sick” to go to school. So when Ashley calls Paige to get her homework, Paige decides Ash needs to join them in a little fun.
Maya is not feeling very good about herself, so she lets Tori give her a pageant-style makeover.
Maya's friendship with Tori is tested when both girls compete in the Miss Millennial pageant.

Once again, as things finally start to come together for Sean, the other shoe drops - his brother and guardian, Tracker, has found a new job in Alberta. Sean thinks his life is over until he finds out that he can legally live on his own.
Frustrated with her heavy workload, Alli decides to have a little fun -- with or without Dave.

The year end semi-formal is only hours away and Marco has transformed the gym into an idealized Bombay. It promises to be an amazing event, except Marco’s theme is causing tension between him and Ellie. Ellie finds the whole idea racist
After several days without sleep, Alli crashes at the worst possible time.
It’s the end of summer and Paige receives some unexpected news - her rape case has finally made it to trial and she’s the star witness. Finally…justice!
At the Battle of the Bands, Adam really hits it off with Missy, another musician.

Shocked by the outcome of the trial, Paige holes up in her room. But when Marco is able to coax her out to party at Dylan’s dorm with the gang, things go from bad to worse when she and Spinner have a blow-out fight.
As WhisperHug prepares for the band competition, things get messy between Adam and Missy.

Marco’s a shoo-in for Student Council President until Alex enters the race. While at first Alex seems an unlikely candidate, her strong opinions and anti-establishment platform take hold with the students and Marco realizes she might well win.
Drew can’t wait to tie the knot with Bianca in Vegas.
Feeling ignored on Student Council, Emma finds a way to get her voice heard when she takes up a new cause - ganging up with the cool kids to keep Terri’s abusive ex-boyfriend Rick, out of Degrassi.
Drew can’t wait to tie the knot with Bianca in Vegas.
Things are going great for Sean and Ellie, Degrassi’s most unlikely couple—so well that Sean asks Ellie to move in. Despite their closeness, Ellie hesitates and Sean doesn’t understand why.
During Spirit Week at Degrassi, everyone has something to prove.
In her quest to repay Spinner for damage to his car, Alpha Paige has gone all beta. Suddenly, Spin’s using his new-found powers to zap whatever self-confidence Paige has left.
When tragedy strikes at Degrassi, everyone deals with the situation in a different way.
Rick decides to get back at his bullies, hitting them right where it hurts – their cars. But when Jimmy becomes a member of the “Whack Your Brain” team, the two form a truce.
Haunted by Degrassi's recent tragedy, Eli invites Jake and Mo to a secret party..
Worried about Eli's mental state, Clare becomes overprotective.

Rick returns to Degrassi after the “Whack Your Brain” debacle at the hands of Spinner, Jay, and Alex. Toby and Mr. Raditch try to convince him to take the afternoon off, to go home and cool off, but an oddly calm Rick chooses to stay.
After Drew moves out, there's a break-in at the loft, and Fiona fears for her safety.
After the shooting at Degrassi, the full school board counseling response team moves in. And so does the media. Local reporter, Rachel Roberts, has decided to make Sean the hero of her piece.
Fiona takes drastic measures to feel safer at home, and puts herself in danger.

Craig has a problem – the recording deal he and his band won last year is about to expire, but “Downtown Sasquatch” is nowhere near ready to record. With Jimmy in the hospital, they’re missing a key member.
Clare writes an article that stirs up trouble at school and makes her a new enemy -- Mike Dallas.
Craig’s back with Ashley and he’s determined not to screw it up this time.
Eli organizes a surprise birthday party to cheer Clare up, and starts to suspect that she's hiding something.
Distraught when Ashley refuses his proposal, Craig falls into a major rage, completely trashing his hotel room.
When a group of parents try to stop the play, Eli takes action.

Degrassi has a new hottie in Grade 9 and Manny’s got her eye on him. Especially since her “boyfriend” Spinner can’t even be bothered to take a night off work to come to the Cupid Dance she’s organized.
On opening night for Romeo and Jules, Tristan is nowhere to be found.

Something’s wrong with Emma. Though she’s frustrated at being treated with kid gloves by everyone since the school shooting, she’s not sure how she’d rather be treated. So she just keeps going on, numbly reassuring everyone that she’s fine.
As Becky begins to fall for Adam, she worries how her conservative parents will react.
Emma steps into the lead role in Dracula, but her recent extra-curricular activities with Jay prove even more dramatic.
Becky doesn't want to keep Adam a secret, so she decides to tell her parents that he's transgender.
